limits: Improvements apply to QUADRATIC_LEAST_SQUARES; curved/skewed WLS accuracy is unchanged.
Coarse doubly curved/skewed wall transverse error increases 12.1190% to 14.0426%, then decreases to 6.48616% on refinement.
Unsupported wall-edge/corner corrections retain quadratic errors; complete cubic accuracy is not established.
Symmetry/periodic and differentiated QR remain unsupported. Syntax checks are not differentiated runtime validation.
Frozen restart checks establish metric properties, not improved forces, wall y+, accepted adaptation, flow convergence, or native 3D remeshing.
Composed geometric BL transport remains a measured residual, not a gradation certificate.
RAE composed complexity is checked against production reports; no new independent continuous quadrature certificate.
Three paired timing samples under contention are not a universal speedup or a bound on overhead.

retained_candidates.stronger_distance_weight: Rejected: difficult wall gain but simpler 3D wall normal error more than doubles; localization header/log retained.
retained_candidates.unrestricted_cubic: Narrowed to wall-only after worse 2D interior eigenvalue errors. Its source, tests and all twelve raw runs retained.
retained_candidates.full_cubic_and_tangent_only: Exploratory Python screens exposed unstable thin-direction/edge derivatives. Final partial cubic and condition guard prevent these extensions.
retained_candidates.initial_screen_legacy_selector: Initial weighting screen approximated the under-redundant ring replacement incorrectly; corrected-baseline-screen and the C++ baseline logs are authoritative. Screens use central-quarter wall groups, distinct from final wall-interior/edge classifications.
